hooks.command: f=$(node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>console.log(JSON.parse(s).tool_input.file_path||''))"); case "$f" in *.py) (cd backend && uv run ruff format "$f" && uv run ruff check --fix "$f") 2>/dev/null || true;; *.ts|*.tsx) (cd frontend && npx --no-install prettier --write "$f") 2>/dev/null || true;; esac; exit 0
